profile.summary: tunniclm is a Mid-Level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Express.js and Node.js backend ecosystems. Their contributions focus on core framework improvements, dependency management, API deprecation, and documentation. The developer demonstrates strong skills in maintaining backward compatibility, enforcing strict error handling, and automating release processes. While primarily backend-oriented, their contributions reflect deep familiarity with Node.js tooling, semantic versioning, and collaborative open-source practices within the Express.js project.
